newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Oct 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Oct 23.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on Oct 23. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy. Telephone: (6221) 384-6364. Fax: (6221) 344-8404.
President Suharto said that Indonesia should develop its non-gas exports.

T.P. Rahmat, the president director of PT Astra International, the country's largest automobile manufacturer, said that the company's future was entirely in the hands of its shareholders. Astra has recently been the focus of heavy buying and selling on the Jakarta Stock Exchange.
Indonesia needs to simplify its bureaucratic procedures if it is to compete on the world market in the next millenium, State Secretary Murdiono said on Tuesday.
Relatives and friends yesterday buried the man who they claim died in police custody after being charged with robbery.

The ousted leader of the opposition Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI), Megawati Sukarnoputri, visited some of her supporters in a Jakarta jail on Tuesday. The detainees are being held in connection with violence outside the PDI headquarters in July.

Automobile giant PT Astra International said on Tuesday it posted a net profit of 340.85 billion rupiah in the first nine months of 1996, compared with 271.41 billion rupiah in the year-ago period. Astra said it expected a net profit of 450 billion rupiah for 1996 rising to 614 billion rupiah in 1997.
